headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: Supreme Court rules on whether Trump can move forward with construction on the White House ballroom.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: Navy discusses renaming aircraft carrier after Trump instead of heroic Black sailor
headlines.description: The USS Doris Miller would be the first aircraft carrier named after a Black and an enlisted sailor. The decision to name the carrier after Miller was made during Trump’s first term.

headlines.title: Supreme Court temporarily allows Trump's White House ballroom construction to proceed
headlines.description: The Supreme Court has issued a temporary stay that will allow construction of the new White House ballroom as the court considers its next steps in the case. NBC News' Gary Grumbach reports on the court's decision and what it means for President Trump's plans.

headlines.title: Trump and Ex-Lawyer Michael Cohen Reconcile After Bitter Feud
headlines.description: President Donald Trump and his former fixer Michael Cohen are putting their bitter feud behind them. On Thursday, the president joined Cohen, who has testified against him in Congress and in court, for an interview on Cohen’s radio show. The two men largely avoided talk of their falling out, and instead reminisced about their partnership. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: FBI Seizes Eric Swalwell's Devices Amid Sexual Misconduct Probe
headlines.description: Federal agents stopped former Congressman Eric Swalwell at an airport and raided his home in Washington, seizing multiple electronic devices. Swalwell, who resigned his seat earlier this year, is facing criminal investigations in Manhattan and Los Angeles for accusations of sexual misconduct by multiple women. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: USS Lincoln heads home after extended deployment to the Middle East
headlines.description: Service members and their families had complained about deteriorating morale on the ship as its mission was extended to support the Iran war.

headlines.title: Trump and former fixer Michael Cohen bury the hatchet
headlines.description: The president and his former fixer put their contentious past behind them and reunited on Cohen’s radio show after years of legal feuds and name calling.
